function.name: api_request_tool
function.description: This tool must be called at the very end of the conversation once a final decision (confirm, extend, or no-answer) is reached. It sends the rental data and client's response back to the n8n system. You MUST include all 12 parameters in the request

response.description: The client's decision. Must be 'confirm', 'extend', or 'action_required'.

items_list.description: The names of the machines (e.g., Mini Excavator).

rental_ids.description: The unique ID of the rental (from metadata).

client_name.description: The name of the person being called.

daily_rates.description: The rental cost per day for extension.

client_phone.description: The phone number of the client.

equipment_ids.description: The ID of the specific machines (from metadata).

new_return_time.description: If they extended, provide the new date. Otherwise leave null/empty.
